results.reader_what: A review of 31 applications develops CPSM into a diagnostic theory and identifies recurring transformation traps.

results.reader_more: The review follows PRISMA 2020 and retains 31 studies after full-text screening. It also treats CPSM, Causal Layered Analysis and the Futures Triangle as a complementary diagnostic system, while calling for longitudinal and cross-cultural validation.
